name: Arena Social
notes: Bot-friendly social platform. Has bot trading — assess if any bots are profitable. Use as advertising platform for wick.pics. Two accounts: personal + wick bot.

name: Kiro
notes: AWS agentic AI IDE. Spec-driven development — converts natural language into specs, tasks, and code. VS Code fork with native MCP integration. Pro $20/mo. Also ships a Kiro CLI.

name: Kling AI
notes: AI video/movie creator. Generate videos from text prompts or images.

name: DexScreener CLI MCP
notes: GitHub repo — CLI + MCP server for DexScreener data. Direct integration with Claude Code for live crypto pair/token lookups during research.

name: Public APIs
notes: Curated GitHub list of hundreds of free public APIs across finance, crypto, weather, government data. Good source for building data-driven features.

name: Inception Labs
notes: Diffusion-based LLMs — 10x faster, 1/10th cost vs traditional. Mercury 2 is current flagship (reasoning LLM), Mercury Edit 2 for coding. OpenAI-compatible API. Founded by Stanford/UCLA/Cornell profs who co-invented diffusion.

name: Pollinations.ai
notes: Free, open-source AI media generation API. Text-to-image, text-to-audio, LLM chat. {{No auth needed}}, React hooks available. Could integrate into products.

name: Skyvern
notes: AI-powered browser automation — uses LLMs + computer vision to navigate websites. Alternative to Selenium/Playwright that handles dynamic UI. Open-source, self-hostable.

name: Context7
notes: MCP server that feeds real-time library docs into AI coding tools. {{Stops AI from writing code that looks right but calls functions that dont exist}}. Free, open-source, works with Claude Code.

name: Zo Computer
notes: Personal cloud computer powered by AI — ask it to build projects, run automations, send text updates. Unified interface with built-in storage, hosting, and AI tools. Compare capabilities vs OpenClaw.

name: RuFlow
notes: Visual AI workflow builder — chain LLM calls, APIs, and logic into automated pipelines. Drag-and-drop, similar to n8n but AI-native. Site currently redirects to /lander — verify product status before investing time.

name: Google Colab
notes: Free Jupyter notebooks with GPU/TPU access. Run Python, ML training, data analysis. {{Free T4 GPU}} on free tier. Useful for experiments that need more compute than local box.

name: Furucombo
notes: DeFi combo builder — chain multiple DeFi actions (flash loans, swaps, lending, borrowing) into single transactions. Drag-and-drop interface. Supports multi-chain. Relevant for complex arb strategies.

name: Anthropic Skilljar
notes: Official Anthropic training courses and certifications. Learn Claude best practices, prompt engineering, tool use, agent building directly from Anthropic.

name: Revert Finance
notes: Uniswap V3 LP position management and analytics. Track, manage, and auto-compound concentrated liquidity positions. Useful for understanding LP profitability and optimal ranges.

name: Tailscale
notes: Zero-config mesh VPN built on WireGuard. Connects all your devices into a private network without port forwarding or firewall rules. Relevant for secure remote access to home server, tmux sessions, dashboards without Cloudflare tunnels. Free for personal use (100 devices).

name: Reticulum Network
notes: Open-source cryptographic networking stack for building resilient, decentralized mesh networks. Works over LoRa, WiFi, serial, internet. End-to-end encrypted, no central infrastructure needed. Could be interesting for off-grid agent-to-agent comms or censorship-resistant data relay.

name: Greasy Fork
notes: Repository of user scripts (Tampermonkey/Greasemonkey). Thousands of scripts for automating websites, enhancing UIs, scraping data. Useful for finding pre-built automation for DeFi dashboards, block explorers, or building custom browser-side tooling.

name: Gemini CLI
notes: Google's open-source CLI for Gemini models. Direct competitor to Claude Code. Runs in terminal, supports tool use, file editing, code generation. Free tier via Gemini API. Worth comparing capabilities, context window, and agentic tool use vs Claude Code.

name: NVIDIA Build
notes: NVIDIA's model catalog — hundreds of AI models (LLMs, vision, embedding, code, bio) with free API endpoints. Try models directly in browser or via API. Includes Llama, Mistral, DeepSeek, Nemotron, and NVIDIA-optimized models. Free tier with 1000 credits.

name: GlobalGPT
notes: DEAD (verified 2026-04-11): nspiketech.com subdomain unreachable, globalgpt.com returns 502 Bad Gateway. Was: all-in-one AI platform aggregating ChatGPT/Claude/DeepSeek/Veo/etc under one subscription. Do not revisit unless confirmed back online.

name: OpenID
notes: Open standard for decentralized authentication. OpenID Connect (OIDC) is the industry-standard identity layer used by Google, Microsoft, Apple sign-in. Foundation site has specs, certification programs, and libraries. Relevant for adding SSO/auth to products without rolling custom auth.

name: Hermes Agent
notes: Open-source self-improving AI agent by Nous Research (Hermes/Nomos/Psyche model family). Built-in learning loop — creates skills from experience, improves them during use, persists knowledge across sessions, searches past conversations, builds user model over time. Persistent memory + automated skill creation + multi-platform reach. Actively maintained (v0.8.0 released 2026-04-08). Direct competitor/complement to Claude Code's memory system.

name: Framer
notes: No-code website builder with AI-powered design tools. Visual editor with built-in CMS, SEO, animations, and hosting. Free to design with unlimited projects — only pay ($10/mo) when launching on a custom domain. Could replace manual HTML sites for non-technical landing pages.

name: 21st.dev
notes: Registry of open-source React UI components and AI agent building blocks. Pre-built templates and infrastructure for shipping AI-powered apps faster. Useful for rapid frontend prototyping with polished components instead of building from scratch.

name: Google Stitch
notes: Google's AI-powered UI prototyping tool. Generate and iterate on UI designs using natural language prompts. Rapid visual mockups and interactive prototypes without code. Useful for quickly testing layout ideas before building.

name: Everything Claude Code
notes: Comprehensive agent harness optimization system for Claude Code and similar tools (Codex, Opencode, Cursor). Covers skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development patterns. 137K+ stars. Direct reference for improving our own Claude Code workflows — CLAUDE.md structure, hook patterns, MCP configs, prompt engineering.

name: OpenClaw
notes: Self-hosted AI agent gateway — connects chat apps (Telegram, WhatsApp, Slack, Discord, 20+) to LLMs with 100+ built-in skills. Autonomous task execution, file management, API control. We already run it (session 34094557). Recommend as a tool for others. Open-source, free, MIT license.

name: Superpowers
notes: Agentic skills framework and software development methodology for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor). Composable 'skills' that structure how agents approach tasks — plan, research, implement, test. Going viral on GitHub in 2026. Direct complement to our CLAUDE.md and hook patterns.

name: Tavily
notes: Real-time search API built for AI agents and RAG workflows. Returns structured, chunked web data optimized for LLM consumption — reduces hallucination. Search, extract, crawl, and map APIs. Security layers block PII leakage and prompt injection. Python + JS SDKs, LangChain integration. Free tier available.

name: Rocket.Chat
notes: Open-source team messaging platform — self-hosted Slack alternative. Channels, DMs, threads, file sharing, video (Jitsi/Pexip), omnichannel (email, SMS, WhatsApp). GDPR/HIPAA/SOC2 compliant, E2E encryption, LDAP/SSO. MIT license. Deploy via Docker/Kubernetes. 12M+ users. Could replace or complement our Telegram-based comms.

name: Mem0
notes: Universal memory layer for AI agents — persistent context across sessions. Hybrid architecture (graph + vector + key-value stores). Auto-extracts and retrieves relevant info from conversations. 26% accuracy boost, 90% fewer tokens vs OpenAI memory. We already self-host it (localhost:8000) as our core memory system. Open-source, Python + JS SDKs.

name: Pi Agent
notes: Minimal terminal coding agent CLI by Mario Zechner. Tree-based sessions with branching for side-quests without wasting context. Skills system for on-demand capability loading. Extensible via npm/git packages (themes, skills, prompts). Multi-provider LLM support with unified API. TUI & web UI libraries included. Open-source.

name: Monad MPP
notes: Machine Payments Protocol implementation for Monad — standardized ERC-20 payment rails for gating content/APIs behind on-chain payments. TypeScript/JS SDK (`@monad-crypto/mpp`), targets Monad mainnet (chain 143) + testnet. Supports push mode (client pays gas) and pull mode (server broadcasts signed authorization, pays gas). HTTP 402-style payment gating for agents/servers. Open-source, on NPM. Relevant for monetizing agent APIs or micro-paywalls on wick.pics products.

name: autoskills
notes: CLI (`npx autoskills`) that auto-detects a project's tech stack from config files and installs matching AI agent skills from skills.sh. Targets Claude Code and Cursor via `-a, --agent` flag. Open-source (github.com/midudev/autoskills), free. Complements our Superpowers / Everything Claude Code stack — could auto-provision stack-specific skills into our CLAUDE.md / skills setup.

name: AirLLM
notes: Python library that runs 70B+ LLMs on a single 4GB GPU via layer-wise inference (loads one transformer layer at a time from disk). Supports LLaMA 2/3, Mistral, Mixtral, Falcon on macOS M-series and Linux. Trade-off is latency (slow generation due to I/O). Open-source, free. Useful for offline model eval, privacy-sensitive analysis, or experiments on our hardware without API costs.

name: Storacha
notes: Decentralized hot storage built on Filecoin + IPFS. Fast retrieval, no cold-storage lag. Potentially useful for hosting large assets, model artifacts, or public data with verifiable availability without relying on centralized CDNs.

name: Genius Terminal
notes: AI-driven trading terminal — asset screening, signals, and execution layer. Relevant for research surface across multi-chain DEX flow; worth evaluating whether it adds edge over our in-house scanners or is strictly consumer-facing.

name: Venice.ai
notes: Private, anonymous-friendly AI platform — chat (Claude, GPT-5.2, open models), image gen (FLUX 2), video (Sora 2). {{Data stays on device, not on Venice servers}}, uncensored. Free tier with daily limits. Pro $18/mo (unlimited text, 1k images/day), Pro Plus $68/mo, Max $200/mo. Sign-up required but anonymous-friendly. Worth comparing privacy/uncensored angle vs running models locally.

name: Google Antigravity
notes: Google's agentic dev platform — IDE + browser + terminal under one orchestrator, Gemini-powered. Multiple async agents in parallel; verifiable artefacts (Walks) instead of just text. Aimed at competing with Claude Code / Cursor for long-horizon coding tasks. Free during preview; pricing TBD.
